claim: Amazon Inspector CIS scans benchmark EC2 instance operating systems against Center for Internet Security recommendations; you can run them once on demand or as a scheduled recurring scan, targeting instances by tags. They need Amazon Inspector EC2 scanning enabled for the account, and the instance must be an Amazon EC2 Systems Manager instance.

evidence.quote: Amazon Inspector CIS scans (CIS scans) benchmark your Amazon EC2 instance operating systems to make sure you configured them according to best practice recommendations established by the Center for Internet Security.
You can either run a CIS scan once on-demand or as a scheduled recurring scan.
Amazon Inspector performs CIS scans on target Amazon EC2 instances based on instance tags and your defined scanning schedule.
You can perform or schedule CIS scans after you enable Amazon Inspector EC2 scanning for an account.
The instance is an Amazon EC2 Systems Manager instance.
